Name: DetailedSprites
Author: lainussash
Description:
Implement functions to use 64 x 64 pixels per frame compared to 32 x 32 ones for character sprites. (Currently supports only Farm Animals, Pets and NPCs).
This is an experimental mod. To implement Higher Resolution version of sprites. To implement this, you need to create 64 x 64 version of your 32 * 32 sprites and load them by Content Patcher. There is an example in this mod's [CP] folder. After loading the HD version of sprites, you will need to enable it on Generic Mod Config Menu before loading the save data. (Make sure to enable these before loading otherwise it won't work).
Currently Supported Features:
﻿HD NPCs
HD ﻿Pets
﻿HD FarmAnimals
Since I am not an artist, I made 1 frame of HD sprite as the showcase example.(Referenced to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3408]Monster Girls[/url] mod's BabyWhite Girl).
